Bayesian optimization of eta for BRIER.FULL

BRIERfull.bopt.Rd

Tunes the integration weights for BRIERfull with sequential model-based optimization instead of an exhaustive grid. Each proposed eta vector reweights the pooled external cohorts (target observations keep weight 1, external cohort k receives weight eta_k) and triggers one penalized fit over the full lambda path.

Usage

BRIERfull.bopt(
  X,
  y,
  cohort,
  family = c("gaussian", "binomial", "poisson"),
  criteria = c("gaussian.mspe", "gaussian.rsq", "binomial.dev", "binomial.mcfrsq",
    "binomial.tjursq", "binomial.auc", "poisson.dev"),
  X.val = NULL,
  y.val = NULL,
  bounds = NULL,
  init.grid = NULL,
  init.points = 10L,
  n.iter = 15L,
  acq = "ucb",
  kappa = 2.576,
  acq.eps = 0,
  kernel = list(type = "exponential", power = 2),
  verbose = TRUE,
  ...
)

Arguments

X

A numeric matrix of pooled predictors (n x p).

y

A numeric response vector of length n.

cohort

An integer vector of length n: 0 for target samples, positive integers for external cohorts.

family

A string: "gaussian", "binomial", or "poisson".

criteria

Validation criterion, as in BRIERfull.selection.

X.val, y.val

Held-out validation data. Required.

bounds

A named list of length-2 numeric vectors giving the search box for each external cohort. Defaults to c(0, 10) per cohort.

init.grid

Optional initial design, as in BRIERi.bopt.

init.points

Number of random initial points when init.grid is not supplied.

n.iter

Number of sequential optimization steps after initialization.

acq

Acquisition function: "ucb", "ei", or "poi".

kappa

Exploration parameter for "ucb".

acq.eps

Exploration parameter for "ei" and "poi".

kernel

Gaussian-process kernel specification.

verbose

Logical. Print optimizer progress.

...

Further arguments passed to BRIERi.eta.

Value

An object of class c("BRIER.bopt", "BRIER.selection", "BRIER"), shaped exactly like a BRIERfull.selection result with an added bopt element recording the search.

Details

Like BRIERfull.selection, this supports validation criteria only: information criteria are not defined for the pooled fit.

Note that BRIERfull requires at least one external cohort and cannot fit a target-only model. Setting an eta bound to include 0 downweights an external cohort to zero weight, which is not the same as a target-only fit; use BRIERi with eta = 0 for that baseline.

See also

BRIERfull, BRIERfull.selection, BRIERi.bopt, BRIERs.bopt

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
sel <- BRIERfull.bopt(
  X, y, cohort,
  family      = "gaussian",
  criteria    = "gaussian.mspe",
  X.val       = X.val,
  y.val       = y.val,
  init.points = 10,
  n.iter      = 15
)
} # }
